items.q: I can meet -- I can meet John, Bill, Jack on the bandstand

ctx.x: So you get all kinds of trains of thought and lifestyles and what have you, friends.
I can meet -- I can meet John, Bill, Jack on the bandstand, who will leave me his card, but I have to go through his receptionist to see him in his office.
